    Corner algebras #

    For an idempotent e of a k-algebra A, Mathlib's corner ring IsIdempotentElem.Corner is eAe with identity e. This file makes it a finite-dimensional k-algebra and shows that e (rad A) e lies in the radical of eAe (cornerMk_mem_jacobson).

    The value API and the algebra structure are adapted from LargeIndecomposable/Foundations/CornerAlgebra.lean and CornerRadical.lean of multiplicative-bases-deformations (commit 7b9f39f221d8a420a1531f487a3b93ae6d26ce85). The radical statement is proved here through nilpotence of rad A.
